policy.question: Explore whether two post-hoc selected v057 boundary cells differ when graph/choice group order is reversed within the same seed.
policy.scope: Exploratory boundary cells only; not a general model comparison or shallow/deep selective-control test.
policy.fixed: Exact v057 graph and choice request bytes, model identity/options, all 10 seeds, facts/rules/goal and shallow directive.
policy.intervention: Each model/seed receives graph-choice and choice-graph groups; group sequence and model block order alternate by seed parity.
policy.history: Group-first is not history-free. Metadata does not reset model/cache state. Record immediate preceding inference call.
policy.statistics: Within-seed paired descriptive outcomes; repeated seed is not a new independent problem sample.
policy.incomplete: Unexecuted and unmeasured remain null. Full comparison rates are null unless all actions complete.
policy.budget: 80 new inference calls, 20 model-seed blocks, 40 metadata checks (three HTTP requests each).
policy.source: Historical v057 responses are provenance only, not newly observed outcomes.
